Detected only where the receiver is proven to be a DeviceEntry (a registry lookup, a DeviceEntry annotation, or the async_remove_config_entry_device contract); hass.config_entries is never flagged.
DeviceEntry.primary_config_entry is deprecated and removed in Home Assistant Core 2027.8 -- 'Deprecated, use DeviceEntry.config_entry_id instead.' Devices are now restricted to a single config entry.
DeviceInfo['via_device'] and DeviceRegistry.async_get_or_create(via_device=...) are deprecated -- 'Deprecated, use via_device_id instead.' Removed in Home Assistant Core 2027.8.

DeviceRegistry.async_get_device() is deprecated -- 'Identifiers and connections are only unique per config entry.' Removed in Home Assistant Core 2027.8; use async_get_device_by_identifier() or async_get_device_by_connection().

Reads the config_entries field of a device registry WebSocket result. 'Old fields: config_entries, config_entries_subentries, and primary_config_entry. Reads the config_entries_subentries field of a device registry WebSocket result, removed in Home Assistant Core 2027.8. Use config_subentry_id (and config_entry_id) instead; the old field is derived from them during the deprecation period.

Reads the primary_config_entry field of a device registry WebSocket result, removed in Home Assistant Core 2027.8. Use config_entry_id instead; a device now belongs to exactly one config entry, so they are the same value.
